 RealityTea Updated Wed, October 21, 2026 at 1:47 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Model Candice Swanepoel walked the latest Victoria's Secret Fashion Show in a sheer pink look that drew broad attention, underscoring sustained interest in the brand's runway returns. In a widely viewed X video, Candice Swanepoel poses in pink lacy lingerie with a floral headpiece, wing-like cape, and sheer opera gloves. The clip from the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show shows her runway moments that fans praised on social platforms. Her appearance follows her 2024 and 2025 walks for the brand. Swanepoel also shared past looks on Instagram, writing, "For all the dreamers. Good luck to all the Angels walking today!" The video centers on her latest runway styling and the social reaction to it.
